campaign_scheduled_has_date.name: campaign_scheduled_has_date
campaign_scheduled_has_date.value: "campaign"."status" not in ('SCHEDULED', 'SENDING', 'SENT') or "campaign"."scheduled_at" is not null

document_article_number_check.name: document_article_number_check
document_article_number_check.value: ("document_article"."unit_type" = 'ARTICLE' AND "document_article"."number" IS NOT NULL) OR ("document_article"."unit_type" = 'SECTION' AND "document_article"."number" IS NULL)

interaction_has_subject.name: interaction_has_subject
interaction_has_subject.value: "interaction"."person_id" is not null or "interaction"."organization_id" is not null

recognition_member_of_month_complete.name: recognition_member_of_month_complete
recognition_member_of_month_complete.value: "recognition"."kind" <> 'MEMBER_OF_MONTH' or ("recognition"."committee_id" is not null and "recognition"."month" is not null)

committee_budget_open_approved.name: committee_budget_open_approved
committee_budget_open_approved.value: "committee_budget"."status"::text <> 'OPEN' or ("committee_budget"."student_development_approved_on" is not null and "committee_budget"."vp_finance_approved_on" is not null)

form_window_ordered.name: form_window_ordered
form_window_ordered.value: "form"."closes_at" is null or "form"."opens_at" is null or "form"."closes_at" > "form"."opens_at"

appointment_macroevent_consistent.name: appointment_macroevent_consistent
appointment_macroevent_consistent.value: ("appointment"."kind"::text = 'MACROEVENT_DIRECTOR') = ("appointment"."edition_id" is not null and "appointment"."role_code" is not null)

permanence_decision_person_scope.name: permanence_decision_person_scope
permanence_decision_person_scope.value: "permanence_decision"."committee_id" is not null or ("permanence_decision"."decision" in ('CONTINUES', 'EXIT_OE') and "permanence_decision"."proposed" in ('CONTINUES', 'EXIT_OE'))
